organization: Open Knowledge Foundation Deutschland e.V. / OpenCorporates
license: CC-BY 4.0 (per OffeneRegister); OpenSanctions mirror labels it CC-BY-NC 4.0 - confirm before commercial use
notes: Best free bulk source for German company + officer data. Downloaded and verified (260 MB, ~4 GB uncompressed). Schema = OpenCorporates company schema. Officers include Geschaeftsfuehrer/Prokurist with start/end dates.

organization: Open Knowledge Foundation Deutschland e.V. / OpenCorporates
license: CC-BY 4.0 (confirm; same project as JSONL bulk)
data_freshness: File last-modified 2022-10-21 (newer than the JSONL bulk)
notes: 3.7 GB SQLite, NOT downloaded (size). More recent (2022) than the JSONL bulk. Good for SQL-based exploration / Datasette. Also openregister.db.gz (773 MB, 2019) and .torrent files available in the same directory listing.

license: CC-BY-NC 4.0 (commercial use requires separate OpenSanctions license)
data_freshness: Reprocessed 2026-06-05 but underlying coverage still ends 2019-02-01
notes: FollowTheMoney entity graph (companies + people + orgs + relationships). ~6.4-6.85 GB JSON, NOT downloaded (size). Same underlying data as OffeneRegister, reshaped into entities/relationships. NonCommercial license.

organization: German Federal States justice administrations (Landesjustizverwaltungen) / Justizministerium
formats: xml (SI - structured register content, per document)
license: Free of charge since 2022-08-01 for viewing; terms restrict automated mass retrieval
rate_limits: Terms forbid automated bulk access; community tools self-limit to <=60 lookups/hour; mass automated queries may violate sec. 303a/303b StGB
notes: THE authoritative source, but NO official bulk download and NO official API. Data fragmented across 150+ local courts (Amtsgerichte). 'SI' structured XML is available per document only. Registerbekanntmachungen (announcements) visible only 8 weeks. Not suitable for bulk ingestion under its terms.

organization: Bundesanzeiger Verlag (on behalf of the Federal Ministry of Justice)
license: Basic data free; full financial statements / shareholder lists per-document fee (~EUR 1)
notes: Central portal aggregating Handelsregister + Bundesanzeiger + financial statements. Per-document XML available; no bulk dump or open API. Best for enrichment (financials, shareholders) on specific companies, not bulk ingestion.

license: Official EU service; per-company lookup only
rate_limits: Single-company search UI; no bulk export
notes: Official EU 'bridge' to national registers, real-time. Covers limited-liability companies and branches. Good for authoritative single-company verification (EUID), not bulk.

license: Open-source tool; subject to handelsregister.de terms
rate_limits: Self-imposed <=60 lookups/hour to respect handelsregister.de terms
notes: Python CLI that scrapes handelsregister.de extended search. Unofficial. Only viable for low-volume targeted lookups, NOT bulk ingestion (terms + rate limit).

source_name: Commercial Handelsregister APIs (handelsregister.ai, OpenRegister, Viaductus, Kausate, Implisense)
notes: Paid REST APIs with daily-updated, structured, current data + document retrieval. The realistic path to FRESH, complete, structured German company data if budget allows. Not open data.

National open data catalog (120k+ datasets, CKAN API). Does NOT host the Handelsregister as a company master dataset, but useful for regional business / statistical datasets. Search the CKAN API for 'Unternehmen' / 'Gewerbe'.

organization: Bundesanzeiger Verlag GmbH (on behalf of the Federal Ministry of Justice)
license: Free to VIEW (no fee, no registration) since DiRUG 2022-08-01; reuse/redistribution rights NOT granted by free viewing - confirm before bulk reuse
rate_limits: No official retrieval API/bulk; portal terms restrict automated mass retrieval
data_freshness: Authoritative / current; FY>=2022 on Unternehmensregister, FY<2022 on Bundesanzeiger
notes: THE official financial-statement disclosure under sec. 325 HGB. Free to view but NO open bulk and NO free retrieval API. Detail scales with size class (sec. 267/267a HGB): micro/small file balance sheet only; medium/large add P&L, notes, management report, audit. Official 'Massendatenschnittstelle' (webservice@rt.bundesanzeiger.de) is for SUBMITTING statements (XML/XBRL), not retrieval. Best for per-company enrichment, not bulk ingestion.

data_freshness: Daily updated as statements are published in Bundesanzeiger
notes: Turns Bundesanzeiger financial filings into structured JSON (not PDF). Two endpoints: financial indicators (key metrics) + detailed reports (balance sheet + income statement). Covers 'hundreds of thousands' of companies. The realistic path to STRUCTURED financials at scale. Other vendors with financials: North Data, handelsregister.ai, Implisense, Creditreform, Dun & Bradstreet/Bisnode.

license: Open-source tool (Apache-2.0); use subject to Bundesanzeiger terms
rate_limits: Per-company; queries public Bundesanzeiger search and solves its captcha with a bundled ML model - effectively rate-limited, not for bulk
notes: Bundesanzeiger().get_reports('<company>') returns {report_title: content} incl. annual financial statements. Free and scriptable but per-company, captcha/rate-limited, unofficial. Output still needs XBRL/HTML -> structured parsing (Arelle/Brel/tidyxbrl). Good for targeted enrichment of specific companies; NOT a bulk financials source.
